Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: Represents a customer organization using the HelmLogic application. This entity manages organizational settings and subscriptions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Organization entity.

name.description: The official name of the organization.

hasSubDealers.description: Indicates if this organization works with sub-dealers, which triggers the creation of a default 'Sub Dealer Price Level' in the price book.

defaultCurrency.description: The primary currency used by the organization for financial calculations and reporting (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

subscribedBrandIds.description: References to Brand entities that this organization is subscribed to. (Relationship: Organization N:N Brand)

Brand.title: Brand
Brand.description: Represents a product brand. Organizations subscribe to these brands to manage their products and pricing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Brand entity.

description.description: A brief description of the brand.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a specific product offered by a brand. This is a generic product definition, independent of an organization's specific pricing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

brandId.description: Reference to the Brand that offers this product. (Relationship: Brand 1:N Product)

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit, a unique identifier for the product within the brand's catalog.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition.title: OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition
OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition.description: Defines a custom price level (e.g., 'Retail Price', 'Wholesale Price') that an organization uses for its products. These definitions become dynamic columns in the price book.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Price Level Definition.

organizationId.description: Reference to the Organization that owns this price level definition. (Relationship: Organization 1:N OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition)

name.description: The display name of the price level (e.g., 'Retail Price', 'Tier 1 Wholesale').

description.description: A brief description of this price level.

calculationMethod.description: Specifies how the price level value is determined: 'manual' (entered directly) or 'percentageOfBase' (calculated from a base price).

percentageModifier.description: The percentage modifier (e.g., 1.10 for 10% markup, 0.90 for 10% discount) applied if 'calculationMethod' is 'percentageOfBase'. Null if manual.

basePriceSource.description: The source used as the base for percentage calculations: 'supplierCost', 'costPlusMargin', or 'totalCostIncludingCustoms'. Only applicable if 'calculationMethod' is 'percentageOfBase'.

isSubDealerPriceLevel.description: Indicates if this is the special, system-generated 'Sub Dealer Price Level' for the organization.

OrganizationProductPrice.title: OrganizationProductPrice
OrganizationProductPrice.description: Represents the core pricing details for a specific product as managed by an organization, including supplier cost, margin, and custom costings.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific organization's product pricing entry.

organizationId.description: Reference to the Organization that owns this pricing entry. (Relationship: Organization 1:N OrganizationProductPrice)

productId.description: Reference to the Product being priced. (Relationship: Product 1:N OrganizationProductPrice)

supplierCost.description: The cost of the product from the supplier.

supplierCostCurrency.description: The currency in which the 'supplierCost' is denominated (e.g., 'JPY', 'GBP').

exchangeRateToBaseCurrency.description: The live exchange rate from the 'supplierCostCurrency' to the Organization's 'defaultCurrency'.

baseMarginPercentage.description: The organization's default profit margin percentage applied to the product's cost.

customCostings.description: An array of additional custom cost entries (e.g., shipping, duties) applied to this product's price. These represent user-defined 'other costings' columns.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when this pricing entry was last updated.

OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue.title: OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue
OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue.description: Stores the actual price value for a specific price level for a given product within an organization's price book.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product Price Level Value entry.

organizationProductPriceId.description: Reference to the OrganizationProductPrice entity this value belongs to. (Relationship: OrganizationProductPrice 1:N OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue)

priceLevelDefinitionId.description: Reference to the OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition that defines this price level. (Relationship: OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition 1:N OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue)

priceValue.description: The final price for this product at this specific price level, either manually entered or calculated.

isManuallyOverridden.description: Indicates if the 'priceValue' has been manually set by a user, overriding any automatic calculation based on the price level definition.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when this price level value was last updated.

definition.description: Base collection for Organization entities. Contains core organization details and a list of subscribed brand IDs. Access is restricted to members of the specific organization.
Global collection for Brand entities. This is reference data, typically readable by all authenticated users.
Global collection for Product entities. This is reference data, containing generic product details and its associated brandId. Typically readable by all authenticated users.

Subcollection defining custom price levels for a specific organization. Includes denormalized 'organizationId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the parent organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Unique identifier for the parent Organization.

params.name: priceLevelDefinitionId
params.description: Unique identifier for the Price Level Definition.

definition.description: Subcollection storing the core pricing details for a product within an organization's price book. Includes denormalized 'organizationId' for authorization independence and denormalized 'brandId' (from the Product entity) for efficient QAP-compliant querying and filtering by brand. Access is restricted to members of the parent organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Unique identifier for the parent Organization.

params.name: organizationProductPriceId
params.description: Unique identifier for this specific organization's product pricing entry.

definition.description: Subcollection storing the actual price value for a product at a specific price level. This entity *must* include denormalized 'organizationId' and 'brandId' (from its parent 'OrganizationProductPrice' and 'Product' entities) to ensure Authorization Independence and enable QAP-compliant list queries without complex rule 'get()' calls. Access is restricted to members of the grandparent organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Unique identifier for the grandparent Organization.

params.name: organizationProductPriceId
params.description: Unique identifier for the parent OrganizationProductPrice entry.

params.name: priceLevelValueId
params.description: Unique identifier for the Product Price Level Value entry.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable authorization by adhering to the core design principles of Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation. All organization-specific data is placed under a dedicated hierarchy rooted at `/organizations/{organizationId}`, ensuring path-based ownership and simplifying security rules significantly.

1.  **Authorization Independence & QAPs:**
    *   **Organization-Owned Collections:** Key entities like `OrganizationPriceLevelDefinition`, `OrganizationProductPrice`, and `OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue` are all structured as subcollections of `/organizations/{organizationId}`. For example, `/organizations/{organizationId}/priceLevelDefinitions/{priceLevelDefinitionId}`. This design immediately makes the `organizationId` available in security rules as a wildcard, allowing direct authorization checks (e.g., `allow read, write: if request.auth.uid in get(/databases/.../documents/organizations/$(organizationId)).data.members`). This eliminates the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents to determine access, which is crucial for atomic operations and robust security.
    *   **Denormalization for QAPs (Query-Agnostic Permissions):** To support secure `list` operations and avoid rules acting as filters (QAPs), critical authorization and filtering fields are denormalized into child documents:
        *   The `OrganizationProductPrice` entity, located at `/organizations/{organizationId}/productPrices/{organizationProductPriceId}`, will include a denormalized `brandId` field (copied from the `Product` entity). This allows client applications to efficiently query for product prices belonging to a specific organization and a specific brand (e.g., `db.collection('organizations/{orgId}/productPrices').where('brandId', '==', 'someBrandId')`). This query structure respects QAPs because the `organizationId` is already enforced by the path, and the `brandId` filter is explicitly allowed by its presence in the document.
        *   The `OrganizationProductPriceLevelValue` entity, located at `/organizations/{organizationId}/productPrices/{organizationProductPriceId}/priceLevelValues/{priceLevelValueId}`, is critical. It *must* include denormalized `organizationId` and `brandId` fields. While the `organizationId` is available in the path, its presence in the document reinforces Authorization Independence and allows for more flexible querying. The `brandId` denormalization further aids in QAP-compliant `list` queries at deeper levels of the hierarchy, enabling lists of price level values for a given organization and brand without relying on complex, inefficient cross-collection lookups or rule `get()` calls.

2.  **Structural Segregation:** All documents within a given collection (`priceLevelDefinitions`, `productPrices`, `priceLevelValues`) share the same security requirements (i.e., access is governed by the `organizationId` in their path). This prevents mixing data with different access needs, making security rules simpler and less prone to error.

3.  **Access Modeling & DBAC:** The entire structure leans heavily on Path-Based ownership (`/organizations/{organizationId}/...`), which is ideal for user-owned or organization-owned data. Global reference data like `Brand` and `Product` entities are stored in top-level collections (`/brands/{brandId}`, `/products/{productId}`) for broad accessibility, typically read-only for authenticated users.

4.  **Data Clarity:** Wildcards are descriptive (`{organizationId}`, `{priceLevelDefinitionId}`). The `hasSubDealers` flag on the `Organization` entity directly informs the application logic for creating the 'Sub Dealer Price Level', maintaining explicit state.

This design ensures that authorization rules can be written concisely, typically checking `request.auth.uid` against a `members` map on the `Organization` document for the `organizationId` extracted from the path. The denormalization strategy is paramount in achieving Authorization Independence and supporting robust, QAP-compliant queries for the price book functionality.
